It requires {{CollectionLink|Enderman LVL 6}} to use. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{coll|Enderman Slayer VI}} |A1 = Null Ovoid, 16 |B1 = Enchanted Eye of Ender, 30 |C1 = Null Ovoid, 16 |A2 = Null Ovoid, 16 |B2 = Enchanted Blaze Rod, 15 |C2 = Null Ovoid, 16 |A3 = Null Ovoid, 16 |B3 = Enchanted Blaze Rod, 15 |C3 = Null Ovoid, 16 |Output = Gyrokinetic Wand }} }} == Usage == {{ItemInfo |type = Wand |rarity = epic |item_ability_name = Gravity Storm |item_ability_activation = Left Click |item_ability_description = Create a large {{Purple|rift}} at the aimed location, pulling all mobs together.
{{Dark Gray|Regen mana 10x slower for 3s after cast.}} |item_ability_soulflow_cost = 10 |item_ability_mana_cost = 1,200 |item_ability_cooldown = 30s |item_ability_name2 = Cells Alignment |item_ability_activation2 = Right Click |item_ability_description2 = Apply {{Green|Aligned}} to yourself for {{Green|6s}}, plus 4 nearby players on grouped islands. {{Dark Gray|(Catacombs, etc.)}}

{{Green|{{!}}{{!}}{{!}} Aligned}}
Splits incoming damage and apply it over {{Green|3s}}. |item_ability_soulflow_cost2 = 2 |item_ability_mana_cost2 = 220 |item_ability_cooldown2 = 10s }} When the {{AN|Gravity Storm}} ability is used, the '''Gyrokinetic Wand''' creates a rift at the targeted location {{Green|10}} blocks in radius. All mobs caught within the rift are pulled towards its center and held there for {{Green|4s}}. A wave of black and purple blocks appear: these are visual and have no collision. After the ability is used, its user's {{Stat|mana}} regeneration is reduced by {{Red|10x}} for {{Green|3s}}. The ability costs {{Stat|Soulflow|10}} and {{Stat|mana|1200}} to use and has a cooldown of {{Green|30s}}. The ability can be used on every block from up to {{Green|24}} blocks away from the player. When the {{AN|Cells Alignment}} ability is used, it applies the {{Green|Aligned}} effect to its own user as well as up to {{Green|4}} nearby players for {{Green|6s}}. When any player with {{Green|Aligned}} takes damage, it is reduced by an amount, with the remaining damage applied over {{Green|3s}} instead. Whenever the player takes further damage, the delayed damage will refresh until either the player stops taking further damage or the buff expires. The ability costs {{Stat|Soulflow|2}} and {{Stat|mana|220}} to use and has a cooldown of {{Green|10s}}. == Trivia == * Its left click ability has the highest Mana cost of any abilities with fixed mana cost other than [[Necromancy]] summons and abilities that consume a percentage or all your mana (i.e End Stone Bow) * {{ench|Ultimate Wise}} reduces the Mana costs of both abilities. * The right click ability, Cells Alignment, is based off the ''League of Legends'' item ''Death's Dance'', with it's passive component behaving identically to the item. *The Aligned ability used to cause a bug that could kill Necromancy Summons. *The Gravity Storm ability is commonly used in the [[Catacombs]], and [[The Mist]] to pull mobs together to prevent high damage attacks such as [[Fels]] and [[Shadow Assassin|Shadow Assassins]], and troll [[Ghost]] Farmers by pulling a lot of ghosts towards them. It can also be used in [[The Catacombs - Floor IV]] and [[The Catacombs - Floor VI]] to pull the [[Thorn#Boss Mobs|Spirit Animals]] and [[Sadan#Phase 1|Terracottas]] together for killing them. In [[The Catacombs - Floor VI|Master Mode Catacombs - Floor VI]], the community consider the Gyrokinetic Wand as a must have item. * The Cells Alignment used to be bugged to reduce the damage from [[Kuudra#Boss Fight|Dropships]] in the {{zone|Kuudra's Hollow}}. * The split damage from Aligned is affected by your Defense, further reducing the damage dealt to you. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/Jun 24|[[File:Gyrokinetic Wand (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Gyrokinetic Wand''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} |beta= {{History|2021/May 31|[[File:Gyrokinetic Wand (v1).png|26px]] Added '''Gyrokinetic Wand'''.}} {{History|0.26|[[File:Gyrokinetic Wand (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Gyrokinetic Wand''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Slayer/Enderman}} {{Nav/Wands}}
